name: Keepsake
description: Blueberry cultivar from the Berry Blue programme, selection 'BB05-251MI-14', cited by the rights holder as protected by US PP24,807. The selection code appears independently on the Canadian plant breeders' rights blueberry register, which corroborates the code-to-name mapping without relying on the owner's own list.

attributes.access: described by Hortifrut as exclusive to Hortifrut, MBG and their producers
